proof_audit.topic: Continuous martingale, PDE and boundary scope
proof_audit.reason: The constant Q-GBM solution and finite exponential moments establish square-integrability of the discounted stock integral on the stated finite horizon. Scalar Ito and funded stock/bank gains yield the PDE. The vanilla boundary/terminal payoff and at-most-linear-growth uniqueness route are taught in Chapter8 and explicitly invoked within that class; no arbitrary local martingale, general Girsanov, stochastic-rate or nonsmooth global regularity claim is imported.

Strict d<R<u gives positive transition probabilities. The conditional finite Snell recursion dominates every adapted stopping payment and first optimal exercise attains it, with ties permitted to continue. Added rights enlarge the feasible set only on the same tree law. Full-history counts677/17 and coarsest exercise nodes are consistent; finer output explicitly labels its exercise-node list incomplete. Root holdings are continuation hedges, not instructions after immediate exercise.

The independent-increment normal model supplies exact terminal GBM. Finite lognormal second moments justify signed fixed-control variance formulas and asymptotic fixed-n CLT reasoning. Antithetic pairs are single observations, and equal standalone payoff counts require twice pair variance in the relative mean-variance comparison. Bounded put/pair payoffs support ideal Hoeffding, while the controlled observation is unbounded. The finite deterministic hash experiment does not receive an iid coverage proof, and seed selection is explicitly rejected.

proof_audit.topic: Funded discrete cash and tested buffer
proof_audit.reason: Discounted bank equations telescope into discounted stock gains minus every dated fee and final payoff. The delta rule is independent of bank wealth, so cost scaling and initial-cash shifts are exact under that policy. Unweighted scenarios are not a profit sample or all-path set. No continuous realized-variance formula is substituted for the finite-trade cash identity.

Default occurs before its coupon; only earlier coupons survive, and face recovery is paid once at its declared settlement date. Pricing-law expected savings differ from conditional payment deficits. Negative bank balances expose reliance on a facility rather than establishing one. Five invented gates are conjunctive and their equality/tolerance conventions are stated; passing their restricted demo cannot approve different rights, models or real transactions. The final quote budget is max(riskless fixedPV, selected reserve purchasePV)+put+tested buffer, so a costly selected reserve cannot pass by using only a cheaper reference reserve budget.
